最基础的日期范围选择、日期时间范围选择。.en-us: Basic date range and date/time range selection.

由参数`showTime.defaultValue`设定的默认值，将会在用户初次.en-us: The `showTime.defaultValue` is selected automatically in the time panel when the user first selects a date.

设置参数`placement`控制悬浮层展开方位。.en-us: Use `placement` to set the popup placement.

设置参数`picker`选择不同的日期范围选择粒度。.en-us: Use `picker` to choose the date range selection granularity.

设置参数`format`以实现不同粒度设置下适合的已选内容回填格式化。.en-us: Use `format` to customize the displayed selection for the chosen picker mode.

通过参数`prefix`设置选择框内嵌前缀内容。.en-us: Use `prefix` to embed prefix content in the selection input.

通过参数`suffixIcon`设置选择框内嵌后缀图标。.en-us: Use `suffixIcon` to embed a suffix icon in the selection input.

设置参数`status`强制状态渲染。.en-us: Use `status` to force a status style.

设置参数`disabledDatesStrategy`控制需要禁止用户选中的日期.en-us: Use `disabledDatesStrategy` to determine dates that cannot be selected.

通过参数`extraFooter`自定义选择面板底部额外的内容。.en-us: Use `extraFooter` to add custom content below the selection panel.

通过参数`customCells`对指定规则对应的日期单元格添加额外样式，未填写.en-us: Use `customCells` to style date cells matching specified rules. Omitted conditions act as wildcards.

通过回调函数监听`pickerValue`的变化，获取当前面板停留位置。.en-us: Monitor `pickerValue` to obtain the current panel position.
